articles.title: Why is my preview not changing?
articles.summary: Press F5 (or the "Refresh" button beside the preview) to force it.
articles.what: Quick checks for "Why is my preview not changing". The controls involved are Refresh, Zone order (drag handle and priority), COLOR (section).
when: You asked: Why is my preview not changing?
how: Press F5 (or the "Refresh" button beside the preview) to force it.
Make sure the zone has an area and a finish, and nothing above it claims the same pixels.
Spec-only changes (shine, metal, coat) hardly change the colour preview: look at R METAL / G ROUGH / B COAT.
Make sure the view is not on SOURCE only: use SPLIT or CAR (buttons next to the zoom).
If it says "Preview failed - showing the LAST GOOD render", click that bar; reopen the app if it persists.
pitfalls: Remaining belongs at the bottom.
A zone with no colour, layer or box set does nothing ("No color or region set yet" warning).

combos.why: The full troubleshooting article: every cause, the fix steps and how to confirm.
RESTRICT TO LAYERS (checkboxes per PSD layer): Tick a layer (Car Paint, Sponsors, Numbers, Tape ...) and the zone only covers pixels that exist on that layer.
